items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...And they had a guy called... Mister Something. Oh, what was his name? Mister Bones.

ctx.x: What was a show like that like? What would there be?
Like various comedians and things. Minstrel shows, you know. And they had a guy called... Mister Something. Oh, what was his name? Mister Bones. All that stuff.
So it was still strictly a minstrel thing.
